posts.title: The challenge to draw maps…for someone who gets easily lost.
posts.description: Perhaps my maps only take me where I want to go and nowhere else. Perhaps drawing is the exercise, and perhaps, like Sara Fanelli’s maps of my head, or my home, those are the best places to start.

Instead of a card, I pick a frase or greeting. These letters have made their way into my freezer paper printing for shirts, classroom walls, march signs.
